chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Abdullah ibn Muskān said: He narrated to me al-'Alā' from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him)
He said: 'When you pass by Wadi Muhassir, run (sa') in it, for the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) ran in it.'
And whoever leaves running in Wadi Muhassir, he will return and run in it.

key_terms.السَّعْيَ: Sa'y, the ritual running between Safa and Marwah or in specific locations like Wadi Muhassir
key_terms.صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: Peace be upon him and his family (SAWW)
key_terms.وَادِي مُحَسِّرٍ: Wadi Muhassir, a valley near Mecca where pilgrims run during Hajj

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on running in Wadi Muhassir during Hajj according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the Sunnah of running (sa'y) in Wadi Muhassir during the morning of Eid al-Adha, linking the practice directly to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his progeny). The mention of returning to perform the act if missed underscores its status as a highly recommended (mustahabb) ritual rather than a mandatory pillar, reflecting the practical jurisprudence of the Imams regarding Hajj rituals.
